q: Why won’t Basic PAYE Tools open on my Mac?
a: Since macOS Sequoia, the part of Basic PAYE Tools that runs in the background no longer starts by itself. HMRC’s help page explains a workaround using the Terminal app. PayrollRTI does this for you, so BPT opens with a double-click again.

q: Do I still need to use the Terminal?
a: No. Once PayrollRTI is installed, you do not need to open the Terminal, type commands or press Ctrl+C. Open PayrollRTI and Basic PAYE Tools appears in its own window.

q: Is this an official HMRC app?
a: No. PayrollRTI is a free community tool. HMRC made Basic PAYE Tools, and PayrollRTI simply opens it for you. HMRC has not made or endorsed PayrollRTI.
Yes. Everything runs on your own Mac. PayrollRTI does not send your data anywhere. Your payroll goes to HMRC through Basic PAYE Tools, in exactly the same way as before.

q: Does it work on older Intel Macs and newer Apple silicon Macs?
Which versions of macOS does it work on?
a: macOS Sequoia (version 15), macOS Tahoe (version 26) and later. To check your version, open the Apple menu in the top-left corner of your screen and choose About This Mac.
You can report a problem on GitHub. This is a free tool looked after by volunteers, so we cannot promise a reply time. For problems with your payroll itself, contact HMRC.
